findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax used in i18next-based account UI
findings.body: The account UI uses i18next interpolation with double braces ({{0}}), as the other keys in this file do. Changing error-invalid-multivalued-size to single-brace Java ChoiceFormat syntax ({0}, {2,choice,...}) means the React UI will not substitute the values. Users will see the raw '{0} ... {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}' text. The same problem applies to the admin-ui messages_en.properties change.

findings.title: Italian text placed into Lithuanian translation
findings.body: totpStep1 in the Lithuanian bundle was replaced with Italian text ('Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:'). Lithuanian users will see Italian. The same mistake was made for loginTotpStep1 in login/messages_lt.properties.

findings.title: Traditional Chinese text in Simplified Chinese bundle
findings.body: The new totpStep1 value ('在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一') is Traditional Chinese, but this is the zh_CN (Simplified Chinese) bundle. It should use Simplified characters, e.g. 在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一.

findings.title: Anchor check skips leftover English anchors and is order-sensitive
findings.body: The loop advances the English matcher once per translated anchor and compares the tags pairwise. However, replaceFirst removes the first occurrence of that tag anywhere in the value, not necessarily the one just matched, so for repeated tags it may strip the wrong instance. Also, href attributes are compared verbatim, which is acceptable, but the anchors removed here are never passed through the sanitizer at all, so attribute content is never validated beyond the equality check.

findings.title: English file path derivation is fragile
findings.body: The path to the English file is built with replaceAll on the whole absolute path. The 'resources-community' replacement and the '_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties' pattern operate on the full string; for example, '_en.properties' itself maps to itself. Any directory component containing these patterns would be altered. If the English file does not exist, a RuntimeException is thrown instead of a reported message, which aborts verification of the file.
